headlines.article_text: SpaceX plans to build a $100 billion spaceport in Louisiana Skip Navigation Markets Business Investing Tech Politics & Policy Video Watchlist Investing Club PRO Livestream Menu Key Points Elon Musk's aerospace and defense tech conglomerate announced plans to spend up to $100 billion building a new launch facility in Louisiana on Tuesday. The launch facility will be based in Vermilion Parish, and "support thousands of launches annually," according to a statement from the Louisiana Economic Development office. Musk said in a video that the company would bring "probably 10,000 really exciting jobs" to Louisiana with the spaceport. In this article SPCX Follow your favorite stocks CREATE FREE ACCOUNT Ship 40 is stacked atop Booster 20 in preparation for Flight 13 at SpaceX's South Texas facility in Cameron County, Texas, on July 22, 2026. Reginald Mathalone | Nurphoto | Getty Images Elon Musk is continuing his push into the Southern U.S. with SpaceX , his aerospace and tech conglomerate, planning a $100 billion new launch facility in Louisiana. In a joint statement, the Louisiana Economic Development office said that SpaceX will establish its Starbase, Louisiana in Vermillion Parish to, "support thousands of launches annually." Shares of SpaceX rose about 2.5% on Tuesday after the announcement. Once built, Starbase, LA will serve as the main launch facility for Starship, SpaceX's in-development rocket that is the largest ever built or flown, and which is designed to be fully re-usable. Musk has ambitions to massively expand SpaceX's Starlink satellite network, to launch orbital data centers, and someday colonize Mars. Those ambitions, and justification for SpaceX's nearly $2 trillion market cap, hinge on the success of Starship. Musk said in the video that the company would bring "probably 10,000 really exciting jobs" to Louisiana with the spaceport. In the Tuesday announcement, SpaceX said it would work on a "historic coastal restoration" in Louisiana, in partnership with the state to "bring the marsh back" and ensure the wetlands around its new facility will have "storm protection." Previously, SpaceX has faced community backlash, lawsuits and fines following environmental violations at its first Starbase facility in Boca Chica, Texas, in the company town now known as Starbase. In its first test flight of Starship in April 2023 in Texas, energy from the rocket caused SpaceX's concrete launchpad to explode, and its spacecraft to blow up in mid-air. Chunks of concrete were flung into a nesting and migration site important to some endangered species nearby and a fire chewed through around 4 acres of Boca Chica State Park Land south of the Texas launchpad. SpaceX stock chart In 2024, SpaceX was also found to have violated the Clean Water Act at the Texas launch facility by repeatedly releasing pollutants into or near bodies of water in Texas, a state agency said in a notice of violation focused on its water deluge system. SpaceX's work in Louisiana follows Musk's move from California into Texas, Tennessee and Mississippi. The company said Louisiana was its fourth launch site. Musk's AI venture, now known as SpaceXAI, built out its Colossus data centers and a power plant in Greater Memphis. Before that, Musk relocated the headquarters of his automaker, Tesla , from California to Austin, Texas. Tesla now operates a massive vehicle assembly plant in Austin and is testing its driverless, Robotaxi service and Cybercab vehicles in the region. Tesla and SpaceX, in partnership with Intel , also plan to build a massive AI chip factory in Grimes County, Texas. It will be Waymo's third international city and first in the EU. Waymo has established an early robotaxi lead in the U.S., operating in 11 U.S. cities, with more on the way. Santiago | Getty Images Alphabet 's Waymo on Tuesday said it plans to roll out robotaxi rides in Germany in 2027, marking its third international market and first in the EU. Waymo will start "phased" testing in Munich over the next few weeks, with plans to launch to the public at the end of next year, the company said in a blog post . The testing aims to build high-definition street maps, train autonomous specialists and adapt software to the city's "distinct driving conditions." "Munich is a world-class hub for mobility and engineering, and becoming part of this city marks an important milestone in our global expansion," Waymo co-CEO Tekedra Mawakana said in the post. To date, Waymo has established itself as the dominant robotaxi player in the U.S., though the industry is still in its early days. The company currently operates in 11 U.S. cities, and is working to expand to 19 others, according to its website. Last month, Waymo announced an expansion into San Diego, Las Vegas, Tampa, Florida, and Denver. Munich is the company's third international city, following London and Tokyo , both markets where Waymo is currently testing robotaxis. As of March, Waymo tracked nearly 221 million fully autonomous miles. Susquehanna boosted its price target to $265 from $230, noting that the "longer-term 'custom XPU' story is also brightening amid an expanded partnership with Google." Rosenblatt also raised its price target, to $300 from $240. Marvell is expected to report earnings on Thursday.
